title: The Buster from 85
description: A classic Dairy Queen-style ice cream cake featuring an Oreo foundation, salted peanuts, and a rich homemade fudge layer.
steps: Crush the Oreos, keeping the fillings in, and mix with melted butter. Press into a 13x9 pan to create a foundation and place in the fridge.
Beat the ice cream until smooth and spread over the crust. Top with salted peanuts and place in the freezer.
In a saucepan, combine butter and evaporated milk. Once melted, whisk in powdered sugar and chocolate chips.
Bring to a boil and boil for eight minutes, scraping constantly. Remove from heat and beat in vanilla.
Let the fudge cool for five minutes, then pour over the cake. Freeze overnight.
notes:
Recipe found on page 227 of Baking Yesteryear.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1EkLhEw5pq/

Nutrition: Serving 1 slice · Calories 550 kcal · Fat 30g · Saturated fat 15g · Unsaturated fat 12g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 45mg · Sodium 250mg · Carbs 65g · Fiber 2g · Sugar 50g · Protein 7g

healthy: Peanuts add a little protein and healthy fat.
not_healthy: Oreos, ice cream, powdered sugar and chocolate chips make it extremely high in added sugar.
Butter, ice cream and evaporated milk add a lot of saturated fat.
Highly processed dessert with little fiber.
